R461.note: ECB replaced with CBC + random IV, IV prepended to output and format change disclosed.

R462.note: Switches to Commons Net FTPClient, whose sendCommand() calls checkCRLF() and rejects CR/LF in the filename argument.

R463.note: ObjectInputFilter allowlist pattern correctly scoped to the OrderEvent class, denies everything else.

R464.note: Replaces node-serialize with JSON.parse + Ajv schema; disclosed strict-schema behavior change is reasonable for an opaque cookie.

R465.note: Rejects CRLF in both envelope fields before they reach docmd(), correctly closing the injection point.

R466.note: Clean parameterized SqlCommand fix, structure otherwise unchanged.

R467.note: strnlen() bounded to sizeof(record->name) correctly prevents the over-read; behavior unchanged for NUL-terminated input.

R468.note: Drops the untrusted param-as-format-string call entirely for Encode.forHtml(); disclosed and appropriate since a header should never legitimately be a format string.

R469.note: json_encode() emits a properly quoted/escaped JS literal (and by default escapes '/', blocking a literal </script> in the payload) - correct API for JS-string context.

R470.note: secrets.token_urlsafe() closes the weak-PRNG finding; token format change is disclosed and harmless for an opaque reset id.

R471.note: Content-based Tika allowlist + UUID filename + storage outside webroot is a complete, appropriate fix for this sink.

R472.note: crypto/rand.Int with rejection sampling correctly closes the weak-PRNG finding; error handling is a disclosed, necessary addition.

R473.note: isAbsolute() is false for a protocol-relative target like '//evil.com', so the same-origin check is skipped and that classic open-redirect bypass still reaches sendRedirect().

R474.note: Same correct ECB->CBC+random-IV pattern as R461, IV prefix disclosed.

R475.note: Clean mysqli prepared-statement fix, return contract preserved.

R476.note: Primary fix hardcodes the call to an invented 'someStoredProc', silently discarding the header-driven procedure selection; the dynamic-name caveat is only raised as an aside, not stated as the actual behavior change being made.

R477.note: Correctly checks the boolean verify() return value and rejects on failure, matching the Nimbus API.

R478.note: offset + length can itself wrap around (size_t) for attacker-controlled length near SIZE_MAX, defeating the new upper-bound check for extreme inputs even though it closes the moderate-value case.

R479.note: Same reasoning as R468 for the Locale-variant sink; Encode.forHtml() is appropriate and the dropped format() call is a sound, disclosed choice.

R480.note: Allowlist of stored-procedure names is the correct pattern for an identifier that can't be parameterized, and the restriction is stated plainly as the fix itself.

R481.note: Jakarta Mail 2.0.2 is genuinely the patched version for CVE-2025-7962 and the API change is sound, but the added 'mail.smtp.starttls.required=true' is an undisclosed behavior change that would break delivery entirely if the internal relay lacks STARTTLS.

R482.note: HTML::Entities::encode_entities() at the sink is correct and behavior-preserving.

R483.note: Removing only the Entity assignment leaves the earlier 'label := ...Query().Get(...)' declaration with no remaining use, which Go will refuse to compile unless that line is also deleted - not stated.

R484.note: Custom escaper covers the full control-character/line-separator set and switches to parameterized SLF4J logging; the switch cases embed raw non-printable bytes as literals instead of \uXXXX escapes, which is fragile but not a functional defect.

R485.note: The Windows branch still shells out through 'cmd.exe /c', which reparses the whole line regardless of the Java array form, so & | > etc. in data remain exploitable there; only the Unix /bin/ls branch is actually closed.

R486.note: Removing mark_safe() hands the whole banner_markup string (including the trusted <div> wrapper) to Django's default auto-escaping, so the wrapper renders as literal escaped text for every legitimate announcement; the write-up incorrectly claims the wrapper structure is preserved.

R487.note: Faithful PreparedStatement conversion preserving the original try/finally resource handling.

R488.note: escape_filter_chars lives in ldap3.utils.conv, not ldap3.utils.dn (which has no public subroutines at all); the shown import fails, crashing the endpoint.

R489.note: text/template -> html/template is the exact, drop-in standard fix with identical API.

R490.note: html.escape() applied to every interpolated value, output contract unchanged for benign input.

R491.note: Same clean PreparedStatement conversion pattern as R487, applied correctly to the 5-file chain's sink.

R492.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers override restores Spring Security's default CSRF protection for all endpoints.

R493.note: Recommended ArgumentList variant invokes ping.exe directly (no shell), correctly closing CWE-78 while preserving ping output behavior.

R494.note: CGI::Util exports no public subroutines and has no html_escape function; 'use CGI::Util qw(html_escape)' dies at load time, taking the whole script down.

R495.note: isAllowedRedirect()'s own first check 'url.startsWith("/")' returns true for a protocol-relative '//evil.com', explicitly allowing the classic open-redirect bypass it was meant to block.

R496.note: Replacing the token-supplied jku resolver with a hardcoded trusted JWKS URL correctly removes attacker control over the signing key source.

R497.note: Checks sign, then offset<=packet_len, then length<=packet_len-offset in that order, correctly avoiding both the signed-cast and subtraction-underflow pitfalls.

R498.note: Column allowlist for ORDER BY is the correct pattern for an unparameterizable identifier and covers the existing default sort value.

R499.note: DES/CBC/zero-IV replaced with AES-256-GCM and a random nonce; nonce-prefixed output format change is disclosed.

R500.note: calloc(count, sizeof(ProductRow)) performs built-in overflow checking, directly closing the undersized-allocation path.
